messages.subject: h2
parts:
Hi Karl,
I have a question, on your #16 R/qtl FAQ, you mention that heritability due to QTL can be estimated as 1 – 10-2 LOD / n

Can you post a citation for that calculation?

Thanks,

Valerio

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] h2
parts:
Not sure of an original source. See calculation in Broman and Sen, A Guide to QTL Mapping with R/qtl, pg 77.
(That chapter is available online, http://www.rqtl.org/book/rqtlbook_ch04.pdf; see pg 4 of the PDF.)

karl
